example: Example project: the 蓝城雲境 location pack and the showcase episode D01 (see README.md).
title: 蓝城雲境
setting: A high-end residential development, 蓝城雲境: its 170 m² show flat, the residents' clubhouse and the underground garage. Every location is taken from the property's three official films (films/, locations/locations.json).

linwan.name: Lin Wan
linwan.look: a 26-year-old Chinese woman with a clean oval face, straight natural brows, calm dark almond-shaped eyes, a small beauty mark under her right eye, long straight black hair tied in a low ponytail, almost no makeup, wearing a plain oatmeal-beige cotton trench coat over a white knit top and carrying a worn canvas tote bag.
linwan.keep: small beauty mark under the right eye, long straight black hair in a low ponytail, plain oatmeal-beige trench coat, canvas tote bag
linwan.face_detail: a small beauty mark under the right eye, calm dark eyes, natural brows, bare fresh skin with fine texture.
linwan.hair: long straight black hair tied in a low ponytail at the nape
linwan.costume: a plain oatmeal-beige knee-length cotton trench coat, a white knit top, light-blue jeans, flat white canvas sneakers, a worn natural canvas tote bag
linwan.voice_en: in a calm, low, clear young female voice
linwan.voice_design: 二十六岁左右的年轻女性，音色清冷干净，中音偏低，吐字清楚，普通话标准，语速偏慢。
linwan.voice_sample: 这里的窗户很大，早上的阳光应该能一直照到客厅的地毯上。

suit.look: a 26-year-old Chinese woman with a clean oval face, straight natural brows, calm dark almond-shaped eyes, a small beauty mark under her right eye, long straight black hair now worn loose over one shoulder, subtle refined makeup with muted red lips, wearing a sharp black tailored trouser suit over a black silk blouse and a slim gold watch.
suit.keep: small beauty mark under the right eye, long straight black hair worn loose, sharp black tailored trouser suit, slim gold watch
suit.hair: long straight black hair worn loose over the left shoulder
suit.costume: a sharp black tailored trouser suit, a black silk blouse, a slim gold watch, black pointed heels
suit.face_detail: a small beauty mark under the right eye, calm dark eyes, muted red lips, refined subtle makeup, fine skin texture.

zhaokai.name: Zhao Kai
zhaokai.look: a 32-year-old Chinese man with a narrow face, raised thin brows, small sharp eyes behind thin gold-rimmed glasses, short black hair slicked back with a hard side part on his left, clean-shaven, wearing a slim navy suit, a white shirt, a navy tie and a small plain gold pin on the lapel.
zhaokai.keep: thin gold-rimmed glasses, slicked-back black hair with a hard left side part, slim navy suit with a navy tie, small plain gold lapel pin
zhaokai.face_detail: thin gold-rimmed glasses, small sharp eyes, raised thin brows, clean-shaven skin with fine texture.
zhaokai.hair: short black hair slicked back with a hard side part on his left
zhaokai.costume: a slim navy two-piece suit, a white shirt, a navy silk tie, a small plain gold pin on the left lapel, polished black shoes
zhaokai.voice_en: in a smooth, slightly nasal male voice
zhaokai.voice_design: 三十二岁左右的成年男性，音色圆滑，略带鼻音，中音，普通话标准，语速偏快。
zhaokai.voice_sample: 这套房子的户型是整个项目里最好的，南北通透，采光非常充足。

zhoumin.name: Zhou Min
zhoumin.look: a 45-year-old Chinese woman with a strong square jaw, defined brows, alert eyes with fine lines at the corners, a sleek chin-length black bob, polished makeup with deep rose lips, pearl drop earrings, wearing an ivory tailored skirt suit with a fitted jacket.
zhoumin.keep: sleek chin-length black bob, pearl drop earrings, ivory tailored skirt suit, fine lines at the eye corners
zhoumin.face_detail: fine lines at the corners of the eyes, defined brows, deep rose lips, polished makeup, mature skin texture.
zhoumin.hair: a sleek chin-length straight black bob
zhoumin.costume: an ivory tailored skirt suit with a fitted jacket, pearl drop earrings, nude pointed heels
zhoumin.voice_en: in a crisp, confident mature female voice
zhoumin.voice_design: 四十五岁左右的成熟女性，音色干练清脆，中音，普通话标准，语速适中。
zhoumin.voice_sample: 我们这个项目一共只有四十八户，每一户都是按照私人定制的标准来做的。

flat_foyer.name: show-flat entrance foyer
flat_foyer.look: a luxury apartment entrance foyer with soft ivory leather wall panels and curved corners, a sculptural dark-bronze console table with a white-and-black marble top under a framed dark oil painting, decorative objects on the console, a grey-and-white woven checkerboard rug on light grey stone floor, a cove-lit ceiling
flat_foyer.keep: sculptural dark-bronze console with marble top, framed dark painting above it, ivory curved wall panels with a fluted lower band, checkerboard rug
flat_foyer.light: day; soft daylight spilling in from the living room on the left, warm cove light from the ceiling

flat_living.name: show-flat living room
flat_living.look: an 8.4-metre-wide luxury living room with floor-to-ceiling windows, a long curved ivory boucle sofa and sculptural round white armchairs, a cloud-shaped white marble coffee table with a large dark-red rose arrangement, a large rug with an organic grey-and-white branch pattern, light grey stone floor, a slim white wall shelf full of art books along the side wall, a flat ceiling with linear light slots
flat_living.keep: curved ivory sofa, cloud-shaped marble coffee table with dark-red roses, grey-and-white branch-pattern rug, floor-to-ceiling window wall, long white bookshelf wall
flat_living.light: day; bright low sun through the floor-to-ceiling windows casting long window shadows across the rug

lights.night: night; warm cove light and two floor lamps as the key, the city skyline glowing in deep blue and amber through the floor-to-ceiling windows, soft reflections in the glass; no daylight anywhere

flat_kitchen.name: show-flat open kitchen island
flat_kitchen.look: an open-plan luxury kitchen with a long island of black marble with white veins over a ribbed white curved base, a large dark-red and green flower arrangement, crystal decanters and glasses on the island, a wine display cabinet with glass shelves and slim black-metal glazed partitions, a window wall behind the counter, light grey stone floor
flat_kitchen.keep: black-marble island top with a ribbed white curved base, dark-red flower arrangement, crystal decanters, wine display cabinet with black-framed glass partitions
flat_kitchen.light: day; cool daylight from the window behind the island, soft fill from the living room

flat_master.name: show-flat master bedroom
flat_master.look: a luxury master bedroom with a large bed in grey and ivory bedding with a fringed throw, a soft upholstered ivory headboard wall with curved panels, a corner window with sheer curtains, a pale geometric rug on a dark grey carpet, a white round bedside table and a pendant lamp, a tall black-framed glass display shelf at the door
flat_master.keep: large bed with grey fringed throw, upholstered ivory headboard wall, corner window with sheer curtains, pale geometric rug
flat_master.light: day; strong side light from the corner window, warm and soft on the bed

flat_closet.name: show-flat walk-in closet
flat_closet.look: a walk-in closet with a tall dark-bronze and glass display shelf holding designer handbags, curved ivory wardrobe panels, a dressing table with a round mirror beyond, warm dark wood floor
flat_closet.keep: dark-bronze glass display shelf with designer handbags, curved ivory wardrobe panels
flat_closet.light: day; soft daylight from the bedroom, warm accent light on the shelves

flat_guestroom.name: show-flat second bedroom
flat_guestroom.look: a warm second bedroom with a bed in white, grey and black bedding with patterned cushions, a full-height beige fabric headboard wall with vertical panels, two dark bedside tables with small white lamps, a pale patterned runner rug on light grey wood floor
flat_guestroom.keep: beige vertical-panel headboard wall, white-and-black bedding with patterned cushions, two small white bedside lamps
flat_guestroom.light: day; soft even daylight from a window on the right, warm bedside lamps on

flat_bath.name: show-flat master bathroom
flat_bath.look: a luxury bathroom with a long floating vanity in grey stone with a large mirror, a wall-hung toilet, dark grey stone floor, a tall window with frosted lower glass, white bath mat and slippers
flat_bath.keep: long floating stone vanity with a large mirror, dark grey floor, tall window at the end
flat_bath.light: day; bright cool daylight from the tall window, soft mirror light

club_entrance.name: clubhouse main entrance
club_entrance.look: a grand residential clubhouse entrance under a dark canopy, wide light-grey granite steps, polished dark-green marble columns and rose-gold metal pillars, a tall glass facade with a rose-gold revolving door
club_entrance.keep: dark-green marble columns, rose-gold revolving door, wide granite steps, glass facade
club_entrance.light: day; bright low sun from the left raking across the stone steps and glinting on the bronze door, warm interior light glowing through the glass

club_lobby.name: clubhouse grand lobby
club_lobby.look: a double-height luxury lobby with blush-pink walls, ivory arched ceiling vaults outlined in warm light, a giant dark-red leaf sculpture standing on a round inlaid medallion in a polished dark-grey marble floor with white inlaid line bands, glowing arched niches, a floor-to-ceiling glass wall
club_lobby.keep: giant dark-red leaf sculpture on the round floor medallion, ivory arched vaults with light lines, dark-grey marble floor with white inlay bands, blush-pink walls
club_lobby.light: day; soft daylight through the glass wall mixed with warm light from the vault edges and niches

club_lounge.name: lobby lounge
club_lounge.look: a lobby lounge with deep ivory leather sofas and armchairs, low round tables with dark-red rose balls, tall cylindrical floor lamps, a polished dark-grey marble floor with sweeping white inlay curves, a floor-to-ceiling window wall
club_lounge.keep: ivory leather sofa group, dark-red rose balls on low tables, cylindrical floor lamps, window wall
club_lounge.light: day; bright soft daylight from the window wall, warm lamps

club_corridor.name: lift lobby corridor
club_corridor.look: a long luxury corridor with a polished dark-grey marble floor and parallel white inlay lines, ivory walls with curved sculpted edges and glowing pillar lamps, bronze lift doors, a large modern red-and-white painting, ending in a carved stone feature wall with white arch patterns
club_corridor.keep: dark-grey marble floor with parallel white lines, carved stone feature wall at the end, bronze lift doors, red-and-white painting
club_corridor.light: day; warm wall-washer light and pillar lamps, reflections on the marble floor

club_library.name: clubhouse tea and reading room
club_library.look: a dark, intimate reading and tea room with dark wood bookshelves and walls, a long dark wood table with clear rose-tinted acrylic chairs and a large red berry flower arrangement, dark grey marble floor, tall windows with sheer blinds
club_library.keep: long dark wood table, rose-tinted acrylic chairs, red berry flower arrangement, dark wood bookshelves
club_library.light: evening; warm low lamplight on the table, cool blue dusk at the windows

club_vip.name: VIP reception room
club_vip.look: a warm VIP reception room with blush-pink walls and tall vertical light strips, a long ivory leather built-in sofa with dark cushions, a white-and-grey triangle-pattern stone floor, a low dark marble coffee table, a pink blossom arrangement on a dark side table, glass doors to a garden
club_vip.keep: long ivory leather sofa, white-and-grey triangle-pattern floor, blush-pink walls with vertical light strips, pink blossom arrangement
club_vip.light: day; soft daylight from the glass doors, warm vertical light strips

club_stairs.name: clubhouse stairwell
club_stairs.look: a quiet stairwell with smooth ivory wall panels, a slim dark metal handrail, dark-grey marble steps with light nosings, a warm cove light along the ceiling edge
club_stairs.keep: ivory wall panels, slim dark handrail, dark-grey marble steps
club_stairs.light: day; soft warm cove light from above, gentle falloff down the stairs

club_hall.name: clubhouse great hall and bar
club_hall.look: a futuristic clubhouse hall with sculptural ivory tree-shaped columns branching into light-lined ceiling vaults, a long bar counter of green onyx marble with white bar stools, a backlit green onyx display wall, ivory leather sofa groups, a polished dark-grey marble floor with curving white inlay lines, a glass wall onto the garden
club_hall.keep: ivory tree-shaped columns with light-lined vaults, green onyx bar counter with white stools, dark-grey marble floor with white curving lines
club_hall.light: evening; warm light along the vault edges and the backlit onyx, blue dusk through the glass wall

club_billiards.name: billiards room
club_billiards.look: a billiards area off the great hall with a modern pool table with green cloth on a sculptural black base under a long linear lamp, ivory tree-shaped columns, a dark wooden arched door, dark-grey marble floor
club_billiards.keep: green-cloth pool table on a black sculptural base, linear lamp above, ivory tree columns, arched wooden door
club_billiards.light: evening; cool pool of light from the linear lamp on the table, dim warm surroundings

club_banquet.name: private banquet room
club_banquet.look: a private banquet room with a large round dining table for twelve with a marble lazy susan covered in red roses, ivory dining chairs, a tiered crystal chandelier, a white-and-grey triangle-pattern stone floor inlay, taupe fabric wall panels with vertical light strips, a lounge corner with grey velvet sofas
club_banquet.keep: large round table with red roses on the lazy susan, tiered crystal chandelier, ivory chairs, triangle-pattern floor inlay
club_banquet.light: evening; warm chandelier light over the table, soft wall-strip light

club_media.name: private media lounge
club_media.look: a private media and karaoke lounge with dark brown suede wall panels, a long teal-grey leather sectional sofa with rust cushions, glowing turquoise malachite stone coffee tables, mustard-yellow lounge chairs, a large projection screen on the wall, a beige curtain
club_media.keep: glowing turquoise malachite tables, teal-grey sectional sofa, dark brown suede walls, projection screen
club_media.light: night; dim warm downlights, the malachite tables glowing, cool light from the screen

club_pool.name: indoor swimming pool
club_pool.look: an indoor swimming pool with green-blue mosaic tiles, a dark wood slatted ceiling with small downlights, a full glass wall onto the garden, white sculptural sun loungers, warm wall lamps, grey stone pool deck
club_pool.keep: green-blue mosaic pool, dark slatted ceiling, glass wall, white sun loungers
club_pool.light: evening; warm wall lamps and downlights reflecting on the water, blue dusk through the glass wall

club_gym.name: yoga and fitness studio
club_gym.look: a bright yoga and fitness studio with a light maple wood floor, a sculptural white mushroom-shaped column with glowing light lines spreading across the ceiling, backlit display shelves with pink exercise balls and yoga mats, white rounded seats, a mirror wall
club_gym.keep: white mushroom-shaped column with glowing light lines, maple wood floor, backlit shelves with pink exercise balls
club_gym.light: evening; warm glowing light lines from the column and ceiling, soft even fill

garage_drive.name: underground garage driveway
garage_drive.look: a high-end underground car park with a polished light terrazzo driveway with white lane arrows, a dark ceiling studded with hundreds of small star-like lights and long white light lines, white columns with marked letters, parked cars along the sides
garage_drive.keep: starry dotted ceiling with long light lines, polished terrazzo driveway with white arrows, white columns
garage_drive.light: night; cool white light from the starry ceiling and light lines, glossy reflections on the floor

garage_lobby.name: garage lift lobby
garage_lobby.look: an underground lift lobby with a glass-walled waiting room, white stone wall panels, two white chairs and a small round table with red roses, polished light grey floor, dark-framed glass doors with a face-recognition panel
garage_lobby.keep: glass-walled waiting room, white chairs and round table with red roses, white stone wall panels
garage_lobby.light: night; clean cool white light, soft reflections on the floor

style: The target video is a photorealistic live-action Chinese urban vertical short drama in 9:16 with cinematic composition, a refined warm-neutral film grade with soft contrast and rich deep shadows, light that is motivated by each location's own sources, and faces with natural skin texture.
